messages.subject: Marsden matter — our engagement
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Gavin,

Thank you for instructing us on the proposed exit of Philip Marsden and his grievance of 29 January. I attach our engagement letter setting out scope, our team and fee estimate (£14k–£20k plus VAT to a negotiated settlement). Tom Gallagher and I will run this with you.

Please sign and return the enclosed copy when convenient. We will revert shortly with our view on merits and a recommended strategy.

Kind regards,
Sarah

Sarah Whitfield | Partner
Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
T +44 (0)20 7946 0100
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
